description:
The bridge is breaking, and Zippy is caught on it! Car cartoon and animated adventure fans, buckle up for a rescue at the Forgotten Speedway.

An old key found in Grandpa Cone's wooden box sends Sprinkles and her friends to the abandoned Forgotten Speedway. A flashback shows young Grandpa Cone choosing to help Buster instead of winning his race, and the crew soon learns why that choice still matters. Out on the mountain road, the competitive cars meet a crumbling bridge, and Zippy ends up in real trouble. Hydro swings into action with the rescue cable while Kraggor holds the bridge up from below, and everyone has to work together to bring Zippy home safely. Teamwork and friendship carry the day.

Subscribe to MegaWheel Arena for more car cartoon adventures! Watch Episode 2: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SdByNtxACP4
